assertions.description: RTCPeerConnection.prototype has no createDTMFSender member (the non-standard method is not part of the RTCPeerConnection interface in webrtc-pc).
Calling pc.createDTMFSender(track) throws (TypeError: not a function) once the method is removed.
assertions.test: (() => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(); try { const t = new AudioContext().createMediaStreamDestination().stream.getAudioTracks()[0]; pc.addTrack(t); return pc.createDTMFSender(t); } finally { pc.close(); } })()

assertions.description: An audio RTCRtpSender returned by addTrack() exposes a non-null RTCDTMFSender via sender.dtmf.
assertions.test: (() => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(); const t = new AudioContext().createMediaStreamDestination().stream.getAudioTracks()[0]; const s = pc.addTrack(t, new MediaStream([t])); const ok = s.dtmf instanceof RTCDTMFSender; pc.close(); return ok; })()

assertions.description: insertDTMF() before negotiation (canInsertDTMF false) throws InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (() => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(); const t = new AudioContext().createMediaStreamDestination().stream.getAudioTracks()[0]; const s = pc.addTrack(t, new MediaStream([t])); try { s.dtmf.insertDTMF('1'); return false; } catch (e) { return e.name === 'InvalidStateError' && s.dtmf.canInsertDTMF === false; } finally { pc.close(); } })()

assertions.description: A video RTCRtpSender's dtmf attribute is null (DTMF only applies to audio).
assertions.test: (() => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(); const t = document.createElement('canvas').captureStream().getVideoTracks()[0]; const s = pc.addTrack(t, new MediaStream([t])); const ok = s.dtmf === null; pc.close(); t.stop(); return ok; })()
